text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I have today off, huh...
How should I spend it? Hmmm...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Someone's... pacing around over there...?

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
! Daaaaantsu! Wanna watch anime together?!
Please!! Pretty please?!

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
There's an anime I just HAVE to get you into!!
I'm begging you! Favor of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Of a lifetime?! S-Sure, I'd love to!
Um, should we head over to your room?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, that's where the rival shows up—... Wait, huh? It ends here?
That went by so fast...

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to hear you say that~! We already watched three episodes!!
Well, the thing is... the best parts are actually still to come...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Really...?! Yeah, let's keep watching together!
I'm super curious to see what happens next too...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew...! That was... that was such an amazing anime...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist running while carrying the feelings of their defeated rival...
Ugh, that hit me right in the heart...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And how they gradually became so conscious of each other, it was just...
Haaah, I got totally sucked in and couldn't stop watching...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: I can't believe we binge-watched it all~! Look at that, you get it completely, Dantsu! There's so much to talk about—

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...?
—! It's already this late?!

One day, while walking through the academy grounds,
I spotted Dantsu Flame chatting with a horsegirl with braided hair.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was so much fun!
I was so surprised to discover something so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Actually,
she introduced me to an amazing anime! And so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And... so... *yaaaawn*... Ah!
I-I'm so sorry! I guess I'm just a little short on sleep...!

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Dantsu! It was your day off, but
you didn't even get to rest properly, did you?! If only I'd stopped us earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Don't say that!
I was the one who asked to watch the whole thing... If anything, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
! Even though you were just humoring me—
...Are you literally a goddess, Dantsu?! Aww, come on...

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! Next time, tell me what you recommend!
I'll do whatever you want to make it up to you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, it's totally fine! You don't have to worry about making anything up to me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I got to find such a great anime!
So just let me hang out with you again next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Eh! ...B-But—...
...Um, okay then!

text_block_list.name: Braided Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I-In that case, I'll totally take you up on that!
Just gotta make sure we don't stay up all night next time! ...Well... see you later, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
See you later~! ...Ehehe♪
I'm happy to hang out anytime, she really didn't need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, shouldn't we be heading out soon too...
? ...Um, is something wrong?

It seemed like the braided horsegirl wanted to say something more
to Dantsu Flame, but swallowed her words at the last second.

Still... hadn't that girl genuinely wanted to share
in the things Dantsu Flame loved?
choice_data_list: Didn't she want to hear your recommendations?
Didn't she want to hear your recommendations?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah... n-no, it's totally okay!
I love hearing what everyone else recommends, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you feel happier having people check out
your own favorite things too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, it's completely fine!
As long as we're both having fun... that's what matters most to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so if you ever feel up to it...
I'd love to hear your recommendations sometime too, Trainer♪
